about_the_game:
■ Overview

Alternative Alliance Alpha (AL2α) is a short, whimsically gentle sci-fi post-apocalyptic adventure set in the distant future. Lighthearted on the surface, yet never without its shadows. Jinovika, a young man, finds himself drawn into a new daily life—exploring the world beyond the colony alongside Armalion, his living partner in the form of a reinforced suit.

■ Features

  • Low commitment, low-calorie playtime (approx. 30 minutes each for Part 1 and Part 2, about 1 hour total*)
  • A wide variety of storylines you won’t see all in a single playthrough
  • Multiple endings
  • Low difficulty—no game-overs or dead ends

*Both Part 1 and Part 2 are included in this single title.
A demo version of Part 1 is available.
There is no save data or story carryover between Part 1 and Part 2.

■ Other Features (for better or worse)

  • Human faces are generally not depicted.
  • The overall tone is relatively calm and subdued.

■ Game System

Explore outside the colony
Gather resources by venturing out. You may also encounter new characters or make unexpected discoveries.


Deliver resources
Turning in resources increases your evaluation level, unlocking new story content and exploration areas.

■ Story

One day, a massive hole tore open in the sky. The sandstorms that poured from it disrupted global communication, leaving each colony isolated. Before long, strange and unknown creatures began to roam the lands outside the colonies. People called them [Hybrid Beasts.] In a world transformed, each colony began to seek its own path to survival.


Time passed since the onset of chaos. Humanity found new ways to live. One of them was the living enhanced suit [Armalion]—gear capable of withstanding both the storms and the hybrid beasts. Though only a few could wear them, these suits became a symbol of hope for those sheltering within the colonies.


This is the story of one such enhanced suit—and the young man who would come to wear it.

content_descriptors.notes:
Certain scenes contain depictions that may suggest death.
Certain scenes contain depictions that may suggest drugs.

short_description: Alternative Alliance Alpha is a short and gentle sci-fi post-apocalyptic adventure set in the distant future. Take control of the young man Jinovika as you explore the world beyond the colony—gathering resources, meeting new people, and enjoying everyday life in this strange world.
